messages:
ben-custsuccess: Heads up — several enterprise customers reporting spikes in 502/504s starting ~09:07 UTC after the 09:00 canary. Tickets opened: INC-4721, INC-4723.

liz-oncall: :rotating_light: Seeing gateway 504s -> backend read timeouts. Error rate jumped to ~14% on prod-route-A between 09:05–09:12.

deploy-bot: deploy finished by ryan at 2026-03-17T09:00:12Z. Release refs/heads/release/seed-response-chunking @sha:abc123. Canary weight went 10% -> 25% at 09:00.

ryan: I rolled response_chunking_v2 + http2_conn_pool in the canary. I think a config binding typo set chunk_size_limit=1 (bytes) instead of 1k. Checking now.

sara: Logs show the chunk assembler hitting an invalid size and then buffering everything; gateway logs show "upstream read timed out" and a mix of 502/504. Some short requests get 502s too.

maddy-product: Customer also flagged duplicated billing webhook deliveries around the same window — looks like retry storms from the client side, but we should confirm idempotency behavior.

ryan: Repro I ran locally:
```bash
curl -v -H \"Authorization: Bearer <token>\" -d '{\"input\":\"short\"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
Intermittent 504. Gateway log sample: 
```text
[proxy] upstream read timed out after 30.002s
[runtime] chunk_assembler: invalid chunk_size: 1
```

sara: Confirmed stacktrace: the parser treats chunk_size < min_chunk as error and falls back to full buffering. That combined with http2_conn_pool behavior keeps connections held open and new requests queue up into the gateway timeout.

liz-oncall: Need immediate rollback. Can we drop canary weight to 0% and revert those two flags? If we can set sane defaults quickly that might avoid a full rollback.

ryan: Initiating rollback now. Commands I'm running: 
```bash
rctl rollout set-weight --route prod-route-A --weight 0 --release refs/heads/release/seed-response-chunking
rctl config set --key response_chunking.chunk_size_limit --value 65536 --env prod
```

deploy-bot: rollback started by ryan at 2026-03-17T09:15:40Z. Canary weight -> 0%.

support-bot: Notifying affected customers INC-4721 INC-4723: outbound update drafted. Estimated rollback completion ~2m.

ben-custsuccess: Thanks — please paste post-rollback metrics when you have them. Customers want ETA for full recovery and notes re: billing credits.

sara: Post-rollback metrics: error rate dropped from 14% -> 0.8% by 09:19 UTC. p95 latency back to baseline. Sampled webhook queue shows no further duplicate deliveries in the 10m window after rollback.

maddy-product: We'll prepare credits for impacted customers. Filing follow-up: add a gating e2e for response chunking flags + validation on chunk_size values.

ryan: Filed ENG-1029 (link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-1029). Will add pipeline guard to reject chunk_size < 1024 and add a smoke test hitting /v1/generate with short payloads.

liz-oncall: Good work. Keep monitoring — we'll close this channel in 30m if stable. :thumbsup:

sara: Postmortem stub created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INCIDENT-1029
